operations.description: Send an HTTP request to a URL, like the Send API Request block. {{secrets.NAME}} in the URL, the headers and the body is replaced with the app's secret, which the code never sees. Responses that aren't 2xx resolve too, only failing to get a response rejects. fetch(url, init) calls it.

url.description: The URL, starting with http:// or https://.

body.description: The body as text, like JSON.stringify(data).

headers.description: Headers by name in lower case, several values joined by commas.

body.description: The body as text, up to 1 MB.

name.description: Name of the variable under Stored variables of the block.

scope.description: Scope of the value, like a user ID for one value per user. Required for scoped variables, ignored for others.

result.description: The value: text, a number, a list, an object, or null.

operations.description: List the values of a stored variable, like a leaderboard of the highest ones.
